summary: Implemented IPL conservative over IPL(→,⊤) for imp-top-only formulas. Created ImpConservative.lean with freeMeetEvaluateEq (embedding coherence lemma), hilbertConjImpConservativeOverImp (ConjImp→Imp conservativity via FreeMeetExtension), hilbertIplConservativeOverImp (full IPL→Imp conservativity), derivableImpOfDerivableInt (subsumption), hilbertIplConservativeOverImp_iff (biconditional), and ipl_conservative_over_imp (ND corollary). All theorems sorry-free with only standard axioms.
